nodePoolName.description: Name of the {@link App.NodePool} for which this App.NodePool.AutoScaleStrategy is responsible for

runIntervalMins.description: How often the scaling CronJob will run. This will directly affect the scaling CronJob's {@link CronSchedule}

maxPctChangeForScaleUp.description: Max percentage difference allowed when scaling up the {link @App.NodePool#targetNodeCount}

maxPctChangeForScaleDown.description: Max percentage difference allowed when scaling down the {link @App.NodePool#targetNodeCount}

timeoutSpec.description:
The timeout for the {@link #scalingLambda} execution.
If not specified, the default {@link TimeoutSpec} will be used.
